My alarms very unfortunately did not ring this morning so I missed the trading day, but it may have been a good one, but it also could have gone poorly all around the 10:00.

The wick was about 30 points, so I would enter off of the ce and take a 100pt tp as there were some 1min equal lows at that level. This would be a winning trade and it either would have been the second trade of the day, or the first.
,
price action was a little slow and choppy today, but still gave this nice setup which I think would be an A or A- because the problem was that es and nq were really uncorrelated: Market pumped at 9:30 open on both assets, but continued to pump much more aggressively on es after 10:00 whereas the nasdaq consolidated more.
,

DAY 24  : 4 TRADES 2WINS 1 BE 1 L (EVALS)

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
So the movement i was looking for yesterday finally happened today. I was right but in the wrong time. we come back down to the OTE level which was 1 HR OB, 5min FVG. I didn't find a breaker i could comfortably take, so i went for RB instead. i referenced the movment from ES compared to NQ as had a good hunch that price would move back to the 5 min RB. Take note that a lot of liquidity was already taken out. I added in my position as i scaled out. To be honest, i should've just kept it static and stop being a bitch.

Second trade, entered off of a pretty strong 5 min RB, hit -4 stdv and touched discount 5/15 min FVG. We were sure to tap and retrace. and from 4HR candle, it's going to be a bearish distribution day. Tapped me in in CE, but i made a half mistake by edging my SL to BE before the high was crossed, but TBH i think powell would have done the same.

Third trade was assuming that we were still bullish because ES still was moving up. It created an SMT, but tbh i should've not longed a bearish SMT. Simple mistake that can be avoided. it was lower risk.

Fourth trade was a silver bullet trade. Saw a breaker aligned with a FVG on the 30 sec, tfa with 5 min. price ran perfectly to TP but i was a bitch and tried to scale out. and hit sell instead of buy to scale out. and freaked out and cut the trade short. What could have been my 1500 day turned to 1000. just put limits in and drag them. safer that way. or just be careful next time. The entry was perfect. 

PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
Execution was perfect. Risk management needs to be worked on. I think because of my lack of confidence, i wanted to take my profits as soon as i saw a potential retracement. Which isn't wrong, but not really my style tbh. and pulling stops early, stop being a bitch and hold it. Also i told myself that's it and went back in, lets catch that next time and be more patient. Don't make the same mistake again bro. (edited)
